chunks: Abu al-Abbas al-Kufi narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Abu Sa'id al-Usfuri, from Amr ibn Thabit, from his father, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, created the land of Karbala twenty-four thousand years before He created the Ka'bah. He sanctified it and blessed it, so it remained sanctified and blessed before Allah created the creatures, and it will remain so until Allah makes it the best land in Paradise and the best abode and dwelling place in which Allah will make His friends reside in Paradise.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance and historical precedence of the land of Karbala in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* establishes Karbala’s ontological superiority by linking its pre-creation sanctity to the eternal divine attributes, distinguishing it from the Ka'bah which, while sacred, was created later. Scholars interpret the '24,000 years' as a symbolic representation of eternity or a specific cosmological era, emphasizing that Karbala is not merely a battlefield but the ultimate eternal abode for the *Awliya* (friends of God). This elevates the site from a historical location of martyrdom to a metaphysical center of divine proximity and reward.
